scope: User-authorized current-private-version Google and email authentication, authenticated resource reads, and non-sensitive habit-click replays in the agent-controlled Chrome and in-app browser surfaces.

interpretation.proven: The current private version completes the Google callback and a standard email-signin page flow, and its authenticated resource-read routes reach the Worker with HTTP 200. In both agent-controlled browser surfaces, a non-sensitive UI habit mutation ends in a generic client network state before a matching Worker mutation event is observed.
not_proven: A defect in an ordinary end-user browser
interpretation.decision: No production API rename, proxy, duplicate route, security relaxation, or visual change was made solely to bypass the agent-browser mutation guard.

next_required_evidence: Run one bounded ordinary-browser write-and-history replay, outside the agent-browser mutation guard, then bind it to the currently deployed private version.
